findings.governingReading: Shirou draws Sakura by the hand toward the front gate.
findings.explanation: The English relocates their approach from the property gate to the house door.

findings.governingReading: They pass through the gate as though returning from school.
findings.explanation: The English skips the threshold and places Shirou inside the house before Rin greets them.
The English leaves Sakura’s hesitant interjection as unexplained Japanese, where it can be mistaken for an address term.

findings.highlight: I can’t even spare to think
findings.evidenceJa: とてもじゃないが思いつかない
findings.governingReading: He cannot possibly conceive how to deal with Archer.
findings.explanation: The English produces a malformed resource claim instead of Shirou’s inability to imagine a countermeasure.

findings.evidenceJa: その先輩が許してくれるなら
findings.governingReading: if Senpai, the person Sakura hurt, will forgive her
findings.explanation: The English reverses grammatical agency and says Shirou has been forgiven by Sakura.

findings.governingReading: Rin shows neither hostility nor murderous intent.
findings.explanation: The English omits the separate and more consequential absence of killing intent.

findings.highlight: we should quickly get changed and warm ourselves up
findings.evidenceJa: 早く着替えて体を暖めないと毒だ
findings.governingReading: They must change and warm themselves quickly or the cold will harm them.
findings.explanation: The English omits the health consequence driving the urgency.

findings.highlight: Did your cold get worse again
findings.explanation: The English replaces recurrence of a fever with worsening of a diagnosed cold.
The English changes Shirou’s condition for dressing warmly from illness type to thermometer reading.
